project.objective: Determine the correct baptism of William Jacob Honeyman (Hunneman) of Hutton Rudby, Yorkshire (d. 1783) — 1716 (Edinburgh) vs 1719 (Hutton Rudby) — and test whether his father William came from Fife, Scotland.
project.title: William Honeyman baptism dispute

researcher_profile.narration_guidance: One-line preamble per skill invocation explaining what you're about to do. Assume basic GPS vocabulary. Define unusual or specialized terminology inline.

questions.question: When and where was William Honeyman (Hunneman), weaver of Hutton Rudby, Yorkshire (buried 27 Mar 1783), baptised — Edinburgh 2 Dec 1716 or Hutton Rudby 5 Apr 1719?
questions.rationale: The tree records a 1719 Hutton Rudby christening while an attached Edinburgh 1716 baptism (parents William Honniman & Elizabeth Duncan) is cited in family tradition and the old IGI; both parish registers survive and are indexed.

questions.question: Where did William Hunneman (d. 1737 Hutton Rudby), father of William bapt. 1719, originate — specifically, is the tree's christening at Scoonie, Fife, 8 May 1692 supported?
questions.rationale: Tree asserts a Scoonie, Fife christening with no attached source, inconsistent with its own birth estimate (~1679); the life sketch calls Fife origin family rumour.

items.rationale: The parish registers and bishop's transcripts hold the 1719 baptism, the family's other baptisms, and the burials and marriages that tie the 1783 weaver to them.
The Edinburgh 1716 christening is the competing baptism; find it and any other Scottish William Honeyman of the period.
The tree gives the father a Scoonie christening of 8 May 1692 with no source; search for it.

log.notes: Found baptisms Ralph 1717, William 1719, Elizabeth 1721 (father William); burials William 1737, Phyllis 1738; marriage William & Catherine Codling 1738; children 1739-1757; burial Willm 1783 and Catherine 1783. Only one William Hunneman household in the parish in any decade; no burial of a child William 1719-1738.

RECONSTRUCTED for the carve. Found the Edinburgh christening of William Honniman, son of William Honniman and Elizabeth Duncan, 2 Dec 1716 (F3BT-5Q7), and a Scoonie christening of 1724 whose father is William Honeyman with Janet Blyth (XYCB-27W).

No christening of a William Honeyman at Scoonie on 8 May 1692 or any date 1670-1695. Only Scottish William christenings in range: Leuchars, Fife 1671 (son of David Honeyman & Margaret Anderson) and Kinross 1688 (son of John Honyman & Helene Whyte). Scoonie had a William Honyman fathering Christian 1688 and a William Honeyman x Janet Blyth baptising 1724-1729. Many contemporary Williams in Fife/Kinross; no record links any to Hutton Rudby.
